missingness_assignment: sha256(protocol_id:model_id:role:modality:intensity:item_id:base_seed) as uint256 divided by 2^256 is below intensity

interventions.transform: replace image vector with zero and set image_present=false before gate and scoring
replace text vector with zero and set text_present=false before gate and scoring
apply the same deterministic item mask to both modalities and set both presence flags false

for each selected item and modality, add deterministic iid Normal(0, intensity * per-dimension FIT-catalog standard deviation), then L2-normalize; PRNG seed is SHA256-derived from base_seed, item_id, modality, intensity

scope: apply to the complete candidate catalog representation before exact scoring; target and non-target items follow the same deterministic item rule

directional_expectations.positive_support: mean router content weight on degraded target items must not increase relative to uncorrupted scoring
directional_expectations.zero_support: sequence branch may be structurally unavailable; degradation may reduce accuracy and no nondegradation gate is asserted

inference.multiplicity: Holm within each intervention family across intensities and declared populations

terminology: adaptive routing; reliability-aware is prohibited unless every separately declared reliability gate passes
failure_policy: missing implementation identity or transformation mismatch makes the affected robustness stage INVALID
